A screenshot of a web page can contain page-controlled content, so UNTRUSTED is supported. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not show delivery to an attacker-readable destination; saving a PNG to a local downloads directory is not, by itself, a SINK as defined. The screenshot might contain private/authenticated/local content, but these lines do not establish that the tool reaches or returns non-public data with user credentials, so SECRET is insufficient.
